faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Madras Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the Senior Research Fellow position at IIT Madras is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a minimum UG in Engineering (Chemical/Mechanical/Metallurgy) with two years of research experience and a valid GATE score, or a Master's degree in Metallurgical & Materials, Mechanical, or Chemical Engineering with specific proficiencies.

faq.question: Q3. Is there an application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for General/OBC, SC/ST, and Women categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs 42,000 plus 30% HRA per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Senior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Senior Research Fellow post at IIT Madras.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online.

faq.question: Q7. What are the key skills preferred for this role?
faq.answer: Proficiency in CFD, multiphase flow, chemical reactions, and experience with FLUENT or COMSOL are preferred skills.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number is ICSR/PR/Advt.161/2026.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Senior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes shortlisting, followed by a test/interview, and document verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the "Important Links" section of this article.
